notes.title: Working on a sequel! Watch the progress if you like!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for playing our game! Your support means everything to us. We are currently working on a sequel. It may take a while (a year?), this is a passion project and definitely not something we can do full-time. I've decided to log our progress here:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UCUfJHfGPFLVF7cRT8w-HbpDkDcs8sTY4Qpzk-VhNZQ/edit?usp=sharing

I'll update it when I can.

I've learned a lot from this game and would love to hear feedback! Please let me know at our email: vuscaluandkiwi@gmail.com
